sectors.name: Technology

US cybersecurity spending momentum, led by CRWD, is forcing Indonesian enterprises to upgrade threat detection, creating a niche but growing local vendor opportunity.

Trim IRSX after its sharp run, as margin recovery is priced in. Watch CRWD for US cyber-spend spillover into Indonesian enterprise security names. Overall, hold overweight tech, favoring local operators over US-listed proxies.

Favor TRJA and BBLD for follow-through, but trim any US-linked financial holdings. Maintain normal risk posture, as the signal suggests no systemic stress, and use pullbacks in BBYB and COIN to add.

Digital distribution and direct-to-consumer channels are reshaping Indonesia's FMCG cost curves, favoring agile mid-caps (KOBX, LUCY) over legacy players.
sectors.ai: Buy selective laggards with strong earnings momentum (SMAR, FAPA) and ignore the aggregate dip; KKES's spike is speculative, so avoid chasing. Position into staples with pricing power and export exposure ahead of rupiah stability, as US weakness is transient. Trim names with weak volume on rallies.
